description.text: This family represents the conserved barrel domain of the 'cupin' superfamily [[cite:PUB00005817]] ('cupa' is the Latin term for a small barrel).

wikipedia.title: Cupin_superfamily
wikipedia.extract: The cupin superfamily is a diverse superfamily of proteins named after its conserved barrel domain. The superfamily includes a wide variety of enzymes as well as non-enzymatic seed storage proteins.

PUB00005817.title: Cupins: a new superfamily of functionally diverse proteins that include germins and plant storage proteins.

representative_structure.name: The crystal structure of a functionally unknown protein RPA4178 from Rhodopseudomonas palustris CGA009
